title: Sentinel Loop Control
code:
#Sentinel Loop Control

print("Enter temperature observations, -300 to stop")
count = 0
sum = 0.0

temp = float(input("First temperature: "))
while temp > -300.0:
    sum += temp
    count += 1
    temp = float(input("Next temperature: "))

if count > 0:
    print("Average temperature =", sum / count)
else:
    print("No valid data entered")

lines.explanation: This is a simple instruction given to the operator of this code
This takes in the first temperature reading as input from the user and stores it in the variable 'temp'
Initializing the while loop and setting in the condition to continue iterating till the temperature is more than -300.0
updating the sum value in each iteration (adding the old value to the newly entered value)
this statement asks for the next temperature reading. This will continue until the loop condition is false
Once the 'while' loop condition is False, the program will exit the loop. It will then start executing statements after of the loop
If the total number of temperatures entered by the user is more than '0'...
then print the average temperature of all the readings
else, give an error warning to the user
